title: AI Impressionism Generator
summary: Make impressionism art with AI: loose brushstrokes, broken colour and fleeting light in oil paintings. Describe it, pick a style, and Flick paints it.
body_markdown:
### How do I make impressionist art with AI?


Describe the scene, the time of day and the brushwork, such as a harbour at sunrise in loose, visible brushstrokes with broken orange and violet colour on the water, then pick an impressionist style and generate. In Flick you can then animate the painting into a clip.


### Can AI turn a photo into an impressionist painting?


Yes. Add the photo as a reference image and ask for an impressionist oil painting of it with loose brushstrokes, broken colour and soft edges, keeping the same composition and light.


### What are the main features of impressionism?


Visible, quick brushstrokes, pure colours placed side by side instead of mixed, coloured shadows, ordinary modern subjects and an interest in light and weather at one passing moment, often painted outdoors.


### Why does my AI impressionist painting have a signature?


Image models learned from signed paintings, so they sometimes paint a fake signature in a corner; add` no signature, no initials` to the prompt and check the corners of every result before using it.


### Is the impressionism generator free?


Yes, it is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 runs on it. Video models such as Seedance 2.5 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).
